title: P52墩柱裂缝不符合项报告
content:
P52墩柱拆模后发现裂缝，已开具NCR-0042。
裂缝须采用环氧注浆修补，并按照GB 50204-2015进行复检。
复检结果须经监理工程师批准后方可关闭NCR-0042。

title: Inspection record Pier P52
content:
Inspection of Pier P52 on 3 October found honeycombing near the base and a crack of 0.3 mm width.
The honeycombing shall be repaired with epoxy injection.
The crack is recorded in NCR-0042.

title: 高处作业施工方案 P47
content:
P47墩盖梁施工属于高处作业，作业面存在临边。
临边必须设置防护栏杆，作业人员必须使用安全带。
高处作业须办理作业许可证，并按照JGJ 80-2016执行。

title: Subcontractor variation request Station S12
content:
The subcontractor requests a variation for additional anchor bolts at Station S12 under Clause 13.3.
The subcontractor also requests an extension of time of 10 days.
The main contractor shall respond within 14 days.

title: 合同通用条款 变更与工期
content:
变更须由监理工程师以书面变更令发出，按照第13.3条执行。
承包商提出工期延长须在事件发生后28天内通知，依据第8.4条。
未经书面指令的变更不得计价。

title: Lifting plan Station S12
content:
The lifting operation at Station S12 requires a lift plan approved by the engineer.
An exclusion zone shall be set up during the lifting operation to control the suspended load hazard.

title: 桥梁支座检查报告 BRG-03
content:
支座检查发现BRG-03存在位移和锈蚀。
锈蚀须进行复检，并按照JTG H11-2004评定。

title: 深基坑开挖安全要求
content:
S07车站基坑开挖存在基坑坍塌风险。
基坑坍塌风险必须采用支护控制，并按照JGJ 120-2012设计。

title: Concrete strength non-conformance P61
content:
Cube results for the concrete pour at Pier P61 show low strength.
The low strength is recorded in NCR-0057.
A core test shall be carried out in accordance with GB 50204-2015.

title: Incident report Pier P61
content:
An incident occurred during formwork removal at Pier P61.
The incident is recorded in SI-0019.
Work at height at Pier P61 is exposed to fall from height and requires edge protection.
